scope: Read-only code quality and evidence-boundary review after specification PASS; current collector, tests and protocol only.

all 267 stored observations preserve raw source, candidate, order, intents and scenario hashes

manualReview: The collector calls the existing validator with one fixed grounded policy and the existing term/item mapper with published flagship objects. Only learningIntentItemIds reaches mapper options; no expected answer, coverage or planning reference is imported or supplied.

The native validator currently maps accepted items in input order. Label-removal indexing therefore matches candidate IDs; submitted, normalized and projected labels remain distinct. Raw extraction and full source fixture references are retained.

Only native DocumentServiceError invalid-content becomes rejected. Unexpected validator/schema/mapper/provenance failures abort the collection; the CLI emits no partial JSON report for those synchronous failures. API details are preserved while CLI diagnostics remain short.

JSON-only input, finite numbers, strict bounded outer schema, iterative canonical serialization, bounded regular-file reads and fatal UTF-8 decoding are clear and proportionate. Existing specification coverage exercises limits and unknown native errors; no new boundary fuzz was needed.

The exact projection, unresolved review points, hints and native empty arrays are preserved. Direct intent variants remain component stimuli; no confirmation, persisted adoption, plan observation or fabricated task coverage is created.

Top-level model/integration/qualification flags remain false, realModelCalls is zero, candidateEvaluation remains incomplete, and partial code provenance explicitly disclaims complete runtime attestation. Protocol states fixture and source-trust limits consistently.
limits: This PASS concerns collector code/evidence quality, not product semantics, model quality, integration, Gate passage or complete candidate evaluation.

The independent 17-group specification suite and root 36-test/lint/typecheck records were inspected rather than rerun. New execution was limited to seven quality groups, 267 stored-record checks, 29 representative native replays and one multi-item API probe.

Native replay proves fidelity to actual component functions, not semantic correctness of those functions. The three source-label losses remain observed product gaps; this review does not repair or approve them.

No model, confirmation/adoption service, planner or user-facing lifecycle was exercised. No app, worker, frozen reference/scorer, existing evidence, commit, remote database, provider or deployment was modified.
Code digests and zero wrapper non-loopback denial events are partial evidence, not dependency closure or complete runtime attestation. Files must remain stable when collecting and archiving.
Final evidence packet/report consistency is pending a separate brief follow-up once the root publishes its final manifest; this does not defer the collector code-quality verdict.
